title: Qubrid AI Compute Entities
description: Schema definitions for Qubrid AI Compute API entities including GPU instances, GPU types, templates, and SSH keys.

Instance.title: Compute Instance
Instance.description: A GPU compute instance on the Qubrid AI platform with NVIDIA accelerators for AI and ML workloads.

id.description: The unique identifier of the compute instance.

name.description: The user-assigned name of the compute instance.

status.description: The current status of the compute instance.

gpu_type.description: The type of GPU assigned, such as H100, H200, or B200.

gpu_count.description: The number of GPUs assigned to the instance.

region.description: The data center region where the instance is deployed.

template.description: The template used to configure the instance environment.

ssh_host.description: The SSH hostname or IP address for connecting to the instance.

ssh_port.description: The SSH port for connecting to the instance.

jupyter_url.description: The URL for accessing the Jupyter notebook interface.

rental_plan.description: The rental plan for the instance.

cost_per_hour.description: The hourly cost of running this instance in USD.

created_at.description: The timestamp when the instance was created.

GpuType.title: GPU Type
GpuType.description: A GPU type available on the Qubrid AI platform with specifications and pricing.

id.description: The unique identifier for the GPU type.

name.description: The display name of the GPU, such as NVIDIA H100 80GB.

price_per_hour.description: The on-demand price per hour in USD.

available.description: Whether this GPU type is currently available for provisioning.

regions.description: The data center regions where this GPU type is available.

Template.title: Instance Template
Template.description: A pre-configured AI and ML environment template for GPU compute instances.

id.description: The unique identifier of the template.

name.description: The display name of the template.

description.description: A description of the template and its pre-installed software.

framework.description: The primary AI or ML framework included in the template.

gpu_compatible.description: A list of GPU types compatible with this template.

SshKey.title: SSH Key
SshKey.description: An SSH public key registered for secure access to GPU compute instances.

id.description: The unique identifier of the SSH key.

name.description: The user-assigned name for the SSH key.

public_key.description: The SSH public key string in OpenSSH format.

fingerprint.description: The fingerprint of the SSH public key.

created_at.description: The timestamp when the SSH key was registered.
